en-US.name: echo tunes
en-US.summary: Play music from YouTube Music on your Echo, from your own server.
en-US.description: A private, self-hosted skill. Say: Alexa, ask my tunes to play, followed by a song or artist. Sign in on your server to play your liked songs, playlists and mixes.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask my tunes to play Blinding Lights
Alexa, ask my tunes to play my liked songs
Alexa, ask my tunes what's playing
